app.name: Google Gemini
app.description: Google's AI assistant that helps with writing, planning, learning, and more using generative AI.

verdict.one_liner: Gemini saves your chats, may review them with humans, and shares data with Connected Apps.
verdict.summary: Google Gemini collects your prompts, file uploads, and Gemini Live recordings. A subset of chats are reviewed by human reviewers and kept for up to three years. Temporary chats are retained for 72 hours. Gemini shares data with Connected Apps and third-party services, which process it under their own privacy policies. You can adjust auto-deletion settings and delete threads manually.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Be careful what you share with Gemini. Some chats are reviewed by humans and kept for years, and Connected Apps may share your data with third parties under their own privacy policies.

red.title: Some chats reviewed by humans
red.plain_english: A subset of your Gemini chats may be reviewed by human reviewers. Google says these chats are disconnected from your account before review.

red.title: Reviewed chats kept for up to three years
red.plain_english: Chats reviewed by humans are kept for up to three years even if you delete your activity. Temporary chats are retained for 72 hours.

red.title: Connected apps may receive your data
red.plain_english: Gemini can connect to third-party apps, which may receive your data and process it under their own privacy policies.

red.title: May activate accidentally and record audio
red.plain_english: Gemini may activate accidentally if it hears something like 'Hey Google,' and it will treat the recording as a normal activation.

green.title: Temporary chats are not used to train AI
green.plain_english: Google states that temporary chats are not used to train its AI models.

green.title: Live streams not used for improvement by default
green.plain_english: Gemini Live voice and video streams are not used to improve Google's services unless you choose to opt in.

green.title: You can export and delete data
green.plain_english: You can export a copy of your content or delete it from specific Google services.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Gemini may record audio and video during Gemini Live interactions, and may accidentally activate if it hears a trigger sound.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy mentions transcripts and recordings of Gemini Live interactions. It also states Gemini may activate accidentally if it hears a noise that sounds like 'Hey Google' and will treat the input like a normal activation.
categories.policy_excerpt: Transcripts and recordings of your interactions with Gemini Live. Gemini Apps may activate when you didn't intend them to... if there's a noise that sounds like 'Hey Google'... treat your input like a normal activation.
concerns: Gemini Live records audio and video

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Gemini collects location information, but the policy does not clearly explain whether this is precise GPS or approximate location.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy mentions location information is collected, but does not specify the precision or whether it is always collected or only on demand.
concerns: Policy does not specify location precision or default behavior

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The policy does not mention whether Gemini accesses your phone contacts.
categories.detail: Neither the Gemini-specific policy text nor the general Google Privacy Policy mentions contact or phonebook access in the context of Gemini.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload files to Gemini, and Google collects these files as part of your interactions.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy explicitly mentions files as part of the information you provide to Gemini Apps.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information you provide Gemini Apps... such as prompts, files

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Gemini shares your data with Connected Apps and human reviewers. Third-party apps process your data under their own policies.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy states that Gemini works with Connected Apps and that third-party apps use data from Gemini consistent with their own privacy policies. It also states a subset of chats are reviewed by human reviewers. The general Google Privacy Policy allows sharing with affiliates, service providers, and for legal reasons.
categories.policy_excerpt: Gemini Apps work with Connected Apps... Third-party apps use data from Gemini consistent with their own privacy policies and terms. A subset of chats are reviewed by human reviewers.
concerns: Third-party Connected Apps have their own policies
Data shared with affiliates and service providers per general Google policy

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need a Google Account to use Gemini, and your activity is linked to that account.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy states it supplements the Google Privacy Policy for signed-in users. The general policy requires a Google Account with name and password, and optionally phone number and payment information.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create a Google Account, you provide us with personal information that includes your name and a password.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The general Google Privacy Policy says personalized ads may be based on activity across Google services, but the Gemini-specific policy does not clearly explain whether Gemini chats are used for ads.
categories.detail: The Gemini-specific policy text does not mention advertising. The general Google Privacy Policy states personalized ads may be shown based on interests and activity across Google services. There is no explicit statement about Gemini chats being used or excluded from ad targeting in the available policy text.
categories.policy_excerpt: Depending on your settings, we may also show you personalized ads based on your interests and activity across Google services.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Google offers Family Link for children under 13.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy references Family Link for children under the applicable age.
categories.policy_excerpt: Google Accounts Managed with Family Link, for Children under 13 (or applicable age in your country)

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Google collects your IP address and device interaction data when you use Gemini.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy lists IP address, crash reports, system activity, and referrer URL as collected interaction data for all Google services, which includes Gemini.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect information about the interaction of your apps, browsers, and devices with our services, including IP address, crash reports, system activity, and the date, time, and referrer URL of your request.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Gemini collects device telemetry and unique identifiers from your device.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy mentions device telemetry is collected. The general Google Privacy Policy lists unique identifiers, browser type, device type, OS, mobile network information, carrier name, phone number, and application version.
categories.policy_excerpt: Information we collect as you use Gemini Apps... device telemetry. The information we collect includes unique identifiers, browser type and settings, device type and settings, operating system, mobile network information including carrier name and phone number, and application version number.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The Gemini policy does not clearly explain whether health or biometric data is collected.
categories.detail: Neither the Gemini-specific policy text nor the general Google Privacy Policy mentions health or biometric data collection in the context of Gemini.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Gemini collects subscription information for paid features, but the policy does not clearly explain what payment details are collected.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy mentions subscription information is collected. The general Google Privacy Policy mentions payment methods added to your Google Account can be used across services.
concerns: Payment details not explicitly detailed for Gemini

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete chats manually and adjust auto-deletion settings, but reviewed chats are kept for up to three years even after deletion.
categories.detail: The Gemini policy states users may adjust auto-deletion settings and erase threads manually. However, reviewed sessions are retained for up to three years and are not deleted when you delete your activity. Temporary chats are retained for 72 hours.
categories.policy_excerpt: Users may adjust auto-deletion from the default span to three months, thirty-six months, or indefinite, and may erase threads manually. reviewed sessions are not deleted when you delete your activity; rather, they are retained for up to three years. Temporary chats are not used to train Google's AI models... retained with your account for 72 hours.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Google promises not to reduce your rights under its Privacy Policy without your explicit consent, and it publishes the date of changes with archived versions available.
categories.detail: The general Google Privacy Policy states it will not reduce your rights without explicit consent, indicates the date of last changes, offers access to archived versions, and provides more prominent notice for significant changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We change this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We always indicate the date the last changes were published and we offer access to archived versions for your review. If changes are significant, we'll provide a more prominent notice.
